# Nadare runtime dependencies, generated from uv.lock. Do not edit by hand:
#
#     uv export --frozen --no-dev --no-emit-project --no-hashes --no-annotate > requirements.txt
#
# (tests/test_lockfile.py fails when this file and uv.lock disagree.) Nadare
# targets Python 3.12+ (see pyproject.toml). Install from a source checkout with:
#
#     python3 -m venv .venv
#     .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
#
# A downloaded Nadare package (AppImage/.deb) bundles these.
#
# Why some of them matter:
#   curl-cffi   STOVE's CDN filters by TLS/JA3; Chrome impersonation is required
#               for the CZN auth and updater paths (plain `requests` gets reset).
#   certifi     the CA bundle curl-cffi trusts; 2026.10.19 removed the
#               compromised eMudhra root.
#   keyring, secretstorage
#               tokens live in the system keyring (Secret Service / KWallet);
#               "Remember me" needs them in the bundled build. See PRIVACY.md.
#   zstandard   HoYo's Sophon chunk manifests and game chunks are zstd frames.
#
